rangeCalendar.$description: RangeCalendar's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--range-calendar-<name>) on the page, a container or one RangeCalendar, and every RangeCalendar inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults. The days themselves follow Calendar's tokens (--calendar-range-bg for the days between the ends).

status.$description: The line under the months that says what to pick next, and the range once it's picked (4.5:1 on the page).

months-gap.$description: The space between two months side by side, or stacked.
